# 获取工单模板

## OpenAPI Specification

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  //openapi/v2/ticket/template/list:
    post:
      summary: 获取工单模板
      deprecated: false
      description: ''
      tags:
        - 工单系统
      parameters:
        - name: appKey
          in: query
          description: 企业的appKey，0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
          required: true
          example: '{{appKey}}'
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: time
          in: query
          description: 当前 UTC 时间戳，从 1970 年 1 月 1 日 0 点 0 分 0 秒开始到现在的秒数,1463217187
          required: true
          example: '{{time}}'
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: checksum
          in: query
          description: >-
            SHA1(appSecret + md5 + time),
            三个参数拼接的字符串，进行SHA1哈希计算，转化成16进制字符(String，小写).示例2f13932c4b7c6888b12360a85261a11b8b543f64 
          required: true
          example: '{{checksum}} '
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                status:
                  type: integer
                  description: 模板状态，-1为全部状态
              required:
                - status
            example:
              status: 1
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ''
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  code:
                    type: integer
                  message:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        id:
                          type: integer
                        name:
                          type: string
                        status:
                          type: integer
                          description: status取0=停用，1=启用，2=已删除
                        autoFlow:
                          type: integer
                          description: autoFlow为是否自动流转，1=是，0=否
                        createTime:
                          type: integer
                required:
                  - code
                  - message
              example:
                code: 200
                message:
                  - id: 12345
                    name: 模板名
                    status: 1
                    autoFlow: 0
                    createTime: 1498736257082
          headers: {}
          x-apifox-name: 成功
      security: []
      x-apifox-folder: 工单系统
      x-apifox-status: released
      x-run-in-apifox: https://app.apifox.com/web/project/605287/apis/api-10845572-run
components:
  schemas: {}
  securitySchemes: {}
servers:
  - url: http://qiyukf.com
    description: 正式环境
security: []

```
